business_problem: Vyond aimed to enhance its enterprise-grade video creation solution, Vyond Studio, by introducing Vyond Go—a generative artificial intelligence (AI)-powered text-to-image service that produces high-quality videos in seconds. To facilitate hosting for multiple generative AI models and ensure scalability for a global customer base, the company chose to run Vyond Go on AWS.
solution_summary: Vyond aimed to enhance its enterprise-grade video creation solution, Vyond Studio, by introducing Vyond Go—a generative artificial intelligence (AI)-powered text-to-image service that produces high-quality videos in seconds. To facilitate hosting for multiple generative AI models and ensure scalability for a global customer base, the company chose to run Vyond Go on AWS. Vyond replicated the AWS architecture used in Vyond Studio when implementing Vyond Go. To enhance scalability and cost efficiency, the company utilized to host several machine learning (ML) models, including Stable Diffusion, a generative AI model that produces unique stylistic images from text and image prompts. In addition, Vyond deployed Amazon EC2 Inf1 instances for other AI-powered features, such as visual content search, video-to-action, and background removal.
